A '''gausser'''<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> was a type of [[Color/Legends|silver]]-colored device consisting of a handle attached to a perforated scoop shaped body.<ref name="TPM" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which includes the appearance of the gausser, to [[32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had<ref name="TPM" /> a broken gausser<ref name="Inside" /> hanging from the ceiling above the workbench in [[Gender/Legends|his]] bedroom, which was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When Skywalker showed [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], whom he had been building on his workbench, the gausser swung around on its hanging as C-3PO sat up.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
A gausser first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The item was first named in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
